pregame.whyWatch: Lincoln Kienholz (LOU QB, Jr): 1534 pass yds, 9 TD, 1 INT, 10.0 Y/A. Big plays with almost no turnovers. The test is whether he still pushes the ball when the first read is covered and the pocket gets muddy.
pregame.pressurePoint: Louisville run game vs Syracuse run defense. Louisville is No. 37 of 138 in rush success rate (49%). Syracuse ranks No. 98 against the run (44%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. Louisville should stay on schedule on the ground, which keeps third downs short and the clock moving. Watch Louisville's rushing attempts by halftime. North of 20 means the plan is working.

edges.why: Syracuse is No. 27 of 138 in pass explosiveness (1.74). Louisville ranks No. 136 at limiting explosive passes (1.96). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Louisville does not keep the lid on. Syracuse will take shots, and the market total may be underpriced if they land.
